Case Description & Question: A 62-year-old African American male presents for routine prostate cancer screening. His PSA level is 4.8 ng/mL, and his DRE findings are normal. He has a brother who was diagnosed with prostate cancer at age 65. What is the most appropriate next step in his management?
Answer Choices:
A) Initiate a prostate biopsy  
B) Repeat the PSA test in 6-12 months  
C) Refer to a urologist for an MRI of the prostate  
D) Schedule a repeat DRE in 6 months  
E) Discontinue prostate cancer screening
Correct Answer: B) Repeat the PSA test in 6-12 months
